people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”
translations.bsb: May God punish David, and ever so severely, if I let one male belonging to Nabal survive until morning.”
translations.kjv: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
translations.asv: God do so unto the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light so much as one man-child.
